name: LDB01
summary: LDB01 is LindenBot’s industrial wheeled humanoid, introduced in April 2026. Its mobile base, lifting torso and coordinated dual arms support handling tasks in manufacturing and logistics environments. The robot integrates the company’s embodied perception and action models with onboard sensing and computing. Public sources document its launch and industrial validation; current ordering and delivery availability are unverified.
